class.name: OcgStandardType
class.brief_description: This class provides legacy interface (type descriptor) to run-time type information (RTTI) for OCCT classes inheriting from Standard_Transient.
class.description: ! This class provides legacy interface (type descriptor) to run-time type ! information (RTTI) for OCCT classes inheriting from Standard_Transient. ! ! In addition to features provided by standard C++ RTTI (type_info), ! Standard_Type allows passing descriptor as an object and using it for ! analysis of the type: ! - get descriptor of a parent class ! - get user-defined name of the class ! - get size of the object ! ! Use static template method Instance() to get descriptor for a given type. ! Objects supporting OCCT RTTI return their type descriptor by method DynamicType(). ! ! To be usable with OCCT type system, the class should provide: ! - typedef base_type to its base class in the hierarchy ! - method get_type_name() returning programmer-defined name of the class ! (as a statically allocated constant C string or string literal) ! ! Note that user-defined name is used since typeid.name() is usually mangled in ! compiler-dependent way. ! ! Only single chain of inheritance is supported, with a root base class Standard_Transient.

method.name: SystemName
method.description: Returns the system type name of the class (typeinfo.name)

method.name: Name
method.description: Returns the given name of the class type (get_type_name)

method.name: Size
method.description: Returns the size of the class instance in bytes

method.name: Parent
method.description: Returns descriptor of the base class in the hierarchy

method.name: SubType_1
method.description: Returns True if this type is the same as theOther, or inherits from theOther. Note that multiple inheritance is not supported.

method.name: SubType_2
method.description: Returns True if this type is the same as theOther, or inherits from theOther. Note that multiple inheritance is not supported.

method.name: Print
method.description: Prints type (address of descriptor + name) to a stream
